title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 534  An Act Converting the Pinaripad Barangay High School in the Municipality of Aglipay, Province of Quirino, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Pinaripad National High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds therefor.

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Pinaripad Barangay tại Thị trấn Aglipay, Tỉnh Quirino thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Pinaripad Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pinaripad Barangay ในเทศบาล Aglipay จังหวัด Quirino เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pinaripad แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Pinaripad Barangay di Kotamadya Aglipay, Provinsi Quirino menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Pinaripad Nasional

text.en:
The Pinaripad Barangay High School in the Municipality of Aglipay, Province of Quirino, is
converted into a national high school to be known as the Pinaripad National High School.

The amount of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be funded out of
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 230 for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports
intended for new national high schools and an additional amount corresponding to fifty percent of its share in
the budgetary aid actually paid to it before such conversion shall be released for its operation from the
national assistance fund to local schools. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and
maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 24, 1983
